description: List a Twitch channel's videos (VOD archive) — the Videos tab at twitch.tv/{channel}/videos. Videos are the channel's own long-form content: past broadcasts (full stream replays), highlights, and uploads — distinct from clips (viewer-created snippets). Filter by video type with --type (all | past-broadcasts | highlights | uploads). Returns cards with title, URL, duration, view count, absolute publish date, category (name + slug), and thumbnail. Queries Twitch's internal GraphQL directly over HTTP; no login or browser required. Paginates by setting the API limit directly up to 100; partial=true when the channel has more videos than returned.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel login name from twitch.tv/{channel} (e.g. "lck"). Lowercase.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Video type filter: all (默认, all types) | past-broadcasts (过往直播, full stream replays, -> ARCHIVE) | highlights (精选内容, -> HIGHLIGHT) | uploads (上传, -> UPLOAD). Maps to the filter dropdown on the Videos tab. The page's extra '播放列表' (collections) option is a separate content type and is not covered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of videos to return (1-100, default 20). Sets the GraphQL limit directly; no page turn needed. partial=true when the channel has more.
